_comment: Machine-readable form of the rules JC has already approved. Derived from 01-Investor-Profile-and-Portfolio.md (2026-11-17) and decisions recorded in the JC Investing project. Programs read this; it never places an order.

zero_fifty_ladder._comment: Extra 0050 purchases on drawdown from the measured one-year high. approved_for_execution stays false: the check only reports that a step has been reached and never suggests buying. Only JC can set this true, because it is the one rule here that would spend money.
zero_fifty_ladder._one_year_high_note: Measured from TWSE STOCK_DAY by scripts/tw_price_history.py. The previous value, 116.5, was derived in conversation on 2026-11-19 and is no longer used: a number that decides where money is spent is looked up, not estimated.
zero_fifty_ladder._amount_note: Default set 2026-11-22 to one month's DCA. The check reports what this amount would buy at the step price so JC is not doing arithmetic on the day. It is a computed figure, not a recommendation, and approved_for_execution stays false.

never: place, modify or cancel any order

relative_review._comment: Replaces the old cost-anchored review line. JC's purchase price is not information about the holding, and a rule triggered by it reacts only to positions that are down, however the business is doing. This compares each holding with 0050 over the same window instead. Decided 2026-11-22 by JC. A review is a prompt to look again; it is never a sell instruction.

unavailable.AVGO: 這個檢查只用免費的台股資料，沒有美股價格，所以 AVGO 無法比較

positions_held_without_addition._comment: 2330 and AVGO are small enough that they cannot change the outcome either way. JC chose on 2026-11-22 to leave them as they are and simply give them a rule. No decision to add or reduce is implied.
